verdict.rationale: Pinecone's docs say a single index can serve full-text search (BM25 token matching with Lucene query syntax over schema text fields, no model required) alongside dense and sparse vector search. Results are ranked via `score_by: text` or `query_string`, so no separate search engine is needed. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the BM25/Lucene full-text feature (community mentions of keyword+vector search are older and vague), and documentation detail on tokenization/analyzers and language support.
